title: The Lantern Walk Pair
youtube_title: The Lantern Walk Pair | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Uma is just outside the fun, close to a lantern walk that should be done in pairs. Vera changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Uma has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
